records.source_text: 巴基斯坦拉合尔项目测量工作计划
records.translation: Lahore, Pakistan Project Survey Work Plan

records.source_text: 根据对已收集的测绘资料的研究，现有测绘资料不能满足设计团队在高程系统、平面系统的精度要求。且水利计算对高程系统有高精度的要求。本次测绘工作将重新开展平面系统的测绘，并建立高精度的高程系统，以充分支撑设计工作的准确开展。
records.translation: Based on the study of the collected survey and mapping data, the existing survey and mapping data cannot meet the design team's accuracy requirements for the elevation system and horizontal system. In addition, hydraulic calculations have high-precision requirements for the elevation system. This survey and mapping work will re-carry out the survey and mapping of the horizontal system and establish a high-precision elevation system to fully support the accurate execution of the design work.

records.source_text: 平面控制网采用分级布设原则：首级控制采用三等GNSS静态测量，加密控制采用一级GNSSS静态测量。坐标系统和投影方式按项目技术设计书执行。
records.translation: The horizontal control network shall adopt the principle of hierarchical layout: the primary control shall use third-order GNSS static measurement, and the densified control shall use first-order GNSS static measurement. The coordinate system and projection method shall be implemented in accordance with the project technical design document.

records.source_text: 约束点间边长相对中误差
records.translation: Relative Mean Square Error of Side Length Between Constraint Points

records.source_text: 约束平差后最弱边相对中误差
records.translation: Relative Mean Square Error of Weakest Side After Constrained Adjustment

records.source_text: （1）选点：点位应选在土质坚实、稳固可靠、便于保存的地方，视野开阔，视场内障碍物高度角不宜超过15°；远离大功率无线电发射源（≥200m）和高压输电线（≥50m）；附近不应有强烈干扰卫星信号接收的物体。
records.translation: (1) Point selection: The point should be selected in a place with solid soil, stable and reliable, and easy to preserve, with a wide field of view; the elevation angle of obstacles within the field of view should not exceed 15°; keep away from high-power radio transmission sources (≥200m) and high-voltage power lines (≥50m); there should be no objects nearby that strongly interfere with satellite signal reception.

records.source_text: （2）埋石：三等控制点应埋设永久性标石，标石规格及埋设深度按CJJ/T 8-2011执行，点位应绘制点之记。
records.translation: (2) Monumentation: Third-order control points should be monumented with permanent markers; the specifications and burial depth of the markers shall be implemented in accordance with CJJ/T 8-2011, and a point description should be drawn for each point.

records.source_text: （3）观测：采用静态相对定位模式，每点观测时段数不少于1个；观测前应量取天线高（互差≤3mm取中数），记录测站名、日期、起止时间、天线高及气象元素。
records.translation: (3) Observation: Use static relative positioning mode, with no fewer than 1 observation session per point; before observation, measure the antenna height (if the mutual difference is ≤3mm, take the mean), and record the station name, date, start and end times, antenna height, and meteorological elements.

records.source_text: （4）数据处理：基线解算采用双差固定解；同步环各坐标分量闭合差及环线全长闭合差应满足规范限差；异步环闭合差应符合W≤2√(3n)σ（n为环中边数，σ为基线测量中误差）；平差前应进行重复基线较差检验。
records.translation: (4) Data processing: Baseline solutions shall use double-difference fixed solutions; the closure differences of each coordinate component of synchronous loops and the total loop closure difference shall meet the specification tolerances; asynchronous loop closure differences shall satisfy W≤2√(3n)σ (n is the number of edges in the loop, σ is the baseline measurement mean error); before adjustment, a repeat baseline discrepancy test shall be carried out.

records.source_text: （5）重点控制：①卫星高度角和PDOP值（PDOP宜≤6）；②时段长度不得因信号短暂失锁而折减；③起算点应联测不少于3个高等级已知点；④约束平差后最弱边相对中误差必须≤1/70000。
records.translation: (5) Key control: ① satellite elevation angle and PDOP value (PDOP should be ≤6); ② the observation session length must not be reduced due to brief signal loss of lock; ③ the starting point should be connected to no fewer than 3 known points of higher order; ④ after constrained adjustment, the relative mean square error of the weakest side must be ≤1/70000.
Relative mean error of the weakest side

records.source_text: 观测技术要求（静态模式）
（1）布设形式：一级GNSS点可在三等首级网下加密，点位密度应满足1:500地形图测图需要，平均边长1km，相邻点间应尽量通视（便于全站仪测图定向检核）。
records.translation: (1) Layout form: First-order GNSS points may be densified under the third-order primary network. Point density shall meet the needs of 1:500 topographic map surveying. The average side length is 1 km, and adjacent points should be intervisible as much as possible (to facilitate total station surveying orientation checks).

records.source_text: （2）观测方式：可采用静态相对定位或基于CORS的网络RTK动态测量。采用RTK时，应符合CJJ/T 73的规定：流动站观测有效卫星数≥5颗，PDOP≤6，每点观测不少于2个测回，测回间平面坐标分量较差≤2cm，取中数作为最终成果。
records.translation: (2) Observation method: Static relative positioning or CORS-based network RTK dynamic surveying may be used. When RTK is used, it shall comply with the provisions of CJJ/T 73: the number of valid satellites observed at the rover station shall be ≥5, PDOP≤6, each point shall be observed for no fewer than 2 observation sets, the difference in plane coordinate components between observation sets shall be ≤2cm, and the mean shall be taken as the final result.

records.source_text: （3）重点控制：①RTK测量必须在获得固定解（FIXED）后方可记录；②RTK点应采用不同基准站或不同时段进行抽检，抽检比例不少于10%，点位较差≤5cm；③一级点应埋设固定标志，位于硬化地面时刻十字或钉水泥钉。
records.translation: (3) Key control: ① RTK surveying must be recorded only after a fixed solution (FIXED) is obtained; ② RTK points shall be spot-checked using different base stations or different time periods, with a spot-check proportion of no less than 10%, and point difference ≤5cm; ③ First-order points shall be provided with permanent markers, and when located on hardened ground, a cross shall be engraved or a cement nail shall be driven.

records.source_text: 高程控制网采用三等水准测量，沿水准路线布设水准点，水准点应选在土质坚实、便于长期保存和观测的位置。高程系统按项目技术设计书执行。
records.translation: The elevation control network shall use third-order leveling. Benchmarks shall be set along the leveling route, and benchmarks shall be selected at locations with solid soil that are convenient for long-term preservation and observation. The elevation system shall be implemented in accordance with the project technical design document.
Mean square error of total elevation difference per kilometer

records.source_text: 附合或环线闭合差（平地）
records.translation: Closure error of connecting or loop line (flat ground)
Note: L is the length of the leveling route (km).
Cumulative difference of front and back sight distances
Minimum height of line of sight above ground

records.source_text: （1）仪器检校：水准仪及水准标尺应在检定有效期内使用；作业前应对i角进行检校，DS1级i角≤15″，DS3级i角≤20″。
records.translation: (1) Instrument calibration: The level and leveling staff shall be used within their valid calibration period; before operation, the i-angle shall be calibrated, with i-angle ≤ 15″ for DS1 and i-angle ≤ 20″ for DS3.

records.source_text: （2）观测方法：采用中丝读数法，往返观测。使用DS3双面尺时，黑红面读数差≤2mm，黑红面高差之差≤3mm；使用DS1因瓦尺时，基本分划与辅助分划读数差≤1mm，高差之差≤1.5mm。
records.translation: (2) Observation method: use the middle wire reading method, with forward and backward observation. When using a DS3 double-sided staff, the reading difference between the black and red faces shall be ≤2mm, and the height difference difference between the black and red faces shall be ≤3mm; when using a DS1 invar staff, the reading difference between the basic division and the auxiliary division shall be ≤1mm, and the height difference difference shall be ≤1.5mm.

records.source_text: （3）测站限差：同一测站不得两次调焦；变换仪器高度观测时，两次高差较差≤3mm。
records.translation: (3) Station tolerance: the same station shall not be focused twice; when changing the instrument height for observation, the difference between the two height differences shall be ≤3mm.

records.source_text: （4）重点控制：①前后视距差和累积差必须逐站检查，超限立即重测；②水准路线应组成闭合环或附合路线，不得布设支线；③观测间歇后应检测两个以上固定点，高差较差≤3√L mm（L为间歇点间路线长度km）方可继续；④闭合差超限时应先分析原因，再就可疑测段重测，严禁局部改数凑差。
records.translation: (4) Key control: ① The difference between the front and rear sight distances and the cumulative difference must be checked station by station, and if the limit is exceeded, it must be re-measured immediately; ② The leveling route shall form a closed loop or a connecting route, and spur lines shall not be laid; ③ After an observation interruption, more than two fixed points shall be checked, and the height difference difference shall be ≤3√L mm (L is the route length between interruption points in km) before continuing; ④ If the closure difference exceeds the limit, the cause shall be analyzed first, and then the suspicious measurement section shall be re-measured; it is strictly prohibited to locally alter data to make up the difference.

records.source_text: 地物点平面位置中误差
records.translation: Mean error of plane position of ground object points
≤0.5 mm on the map (≤0.25 m on the ground)

records.source_text: 高程注记点高程中误差
records.translation: Mean error of elevation of elevation annotation points

records.source_text: 城市建筑区及平坦地区
records.translation: Urban building areas and flat areas

records.source_text: （1）测量方法：采用无人机或GNSS RTK法进行全野外数字测图，内外业一体化。测站设置后应对相邻已知点进行方向和距离检核，方向较差≤30″，距离较差≤1/2000。
records.translation: (1) Survey method: use UAV or GNSS RTK method for full-field digital mapping, integrating field and office work. After the station is set up, the direction and distance of adjacent known points shall be checked, with direction difference ≤30″, and distance difference ≤1/2000.

records.source_text: （2）地物测绘：房屋以墙基外角为准，建筑物应注记结构和层数；道路、管线、水系、植被等要素按CJJ/T 8-2011规定的图式符号表示；隐蔽地物点可采用支导线法测定，支导线边数不超过3条，总长不超过150m。
records.translation: (2) Ground object surveying and mapping: houses shall be based on the outer corner of the wall foundation, and buildings shall be annotated with structure and number of floors; roads, pipelines, water systems, vegetation, and other elements shall be represented according to the legend symbols specified in CJJ/T 8-2011; hidden ground object points may be determined by the spur traverse method, with no more than 3 spur traverse sides and a total length not exceeding 150m.

records.source_text: （3）高程注记：高程注记点应均匀分布，每图幅（50cm×50cm图上=25m×25m实地）不少于10个；重点注记街道中心线、交叉路口、建筑物墙基脚、井口、桥面、广场及地形变换处。
records.translation: (3) Elevation annotation: elevation annotation points shall be evenly distributed, with no fewer than 10 per map sheet (50cm×50cm on the map = 25m×25m on the ground); key annotations shall be made at street centerlines, intersections, building wall foundation footings, wellheads, bridge decks, squares, and terrain change locations.

records.source_text: （4）等高线：按基本等高距测绘首曲线，每隔4条首曲线绘一条计曲线；等高线遇到建筑物、道路、陡坎等应断开。
records.translation: (4) Contours: index contours shall be surveyed according to the basic contour interval, and an intermediate contour shall be drawn every 4 index contours; contours shall be broken when encountering buildings, roads, steep slopes, etc.

records.source_text: ①测站检核必须每站执行，严禁不检核直接测图；
records.translation: ① Station checks must be performed at every station; it is strictly prohibited to directly map without checking;

records.source_text: ②RTK测图时必须固定解，卫星数≥5，PDOP≤6；
records.translation: ② During RTK mapping, a fixed solution must be used, the number of satellites ≥5, and PDOP ≤6;

records.source_text: ③地物点间距在图上大于2mm时应分别采集，不得综合；
records.translation: ③ When the spacing between ground object points is greater than 2mm on the map, they shall be collected separately and shall not be generalized;

records.source_text: ④高程点密度不足区域应补测，确保地形表达准确；
records.translation: ④ Areas with insufficient elevation point density shall be supplemented to ensure accurate terrain representation;

records.source_text: ⑤图幅接边误差：地物≤2倍平面中误差，高程≤2倍高程中误差。
records.translation: ⑤ Map sheet edge matching error: ground objects ≤2 times the mean plane error, elevation ≤2 times the mean elevation error.

records.source_text: （1）断面布设：横断面方向应垂直于线路中线或道路中心线；直线段间距一般20～25m，曲线段、构筑物及地形变化处应加密布设。
records.translation: (1) Section layout: the cross-section direction shall be perpendicular to the route centerline or road centerline; the spacing in straight sections is generally 20 to 25m, and shall be densified in curved sections, structures, and terrain change locations.

records.source_text: （2）测量方法：可采用水准仪-钢尺法、全站仪极坐标法或GNSS RTK法。每个断面应测定中线桩高程及两侧各变坡点、地物点的平距和高差。
records.translation: (2) Survey method: the level-steel tape method, total station polar coordinate method, or GNSS RTK method may be used. For each section, the elevation of the centerline stake and the horizontal distance and height difference of each slope change point and ground object point on both sides shall be measured.

records.source_text: （3）断面宽度：根据工程需要确定，一般应测至道路红线或用地界线外2～5m。
records.translation: (3) Section width: determined according to engineering needs; generally, it shall be measured to 2 to 5m beyond the road red line or land use boundary.

records.source_text: ①断面方向必须与中线垂直，偏角≤5°；
records.translation: ① The section direction must be perpendicular to the centerline, with an deflection angle ≤5°;

records.source_text: ②变坡点不得遗漏，地形平坦处测点间距不宜大于2m；
records.translation: ② Slope change points shall not be omitted, and the spacing of measurement points in flat terrain should not be greater than 2m;

records.source_text: ③横断面高程应与中线桩高程系统一致；
records.translation: ③ The cross-section elevation shall be consistent with the centerline stake elevation system;

records.source_text: ④RTK测量横断面时应进行固定解确认，高程精度不足区域改用全站仪或水准仪施测。
records.translation: ④When conducting RTK cross-section surveys, fixed-solution confirmation shall be performed; in areas with insufficient elevation accuracy, total stations or levels shall be used instead.

records.source_text: （1）二级检查：作业组自检（100%）→ 项目部专检（不少于30%），检查内容包括观测记录、平差计算、精度指标、图面质量等。
records.translation: (1) Two-level inspection: survey team self-inspection (100%) → project department dedicated inspection (not less than 30%); inspection content includes observation records, adjustment calculations, accuracy indicators, drawing quality, etc.

records.source_text: （2）精度评定：平面控制点采用同精度重复测量或已知点检测，高程控制点采用附合路线闭合差评定；地形图采用散点法检测，检测点数不少于总数的5%。
records.translation: (2) Accuracy assessment: horizontal control points are assessed by repeated measurements of equal accuracy or by checking against known points; elevation control points are assessed by closure error of connecting traverses; topographic maps are checked by the scatter-point method, with the number of check points not less than 5% of the total.

records.source_text: （3）成果提交：控制点成果表（含坐标、高程、点之记）、观测手簿、平差计算书、精度评定报告、1:500地形图（DWG/PDF）、横断面图及数据文件、技术设计书与技术总结。
records.translation: (3) Deliverable submission: control point results table (including coordinates, elevations, and point descriptions), observation field books, adjustment calculation reports, accuracy assessment reports, 1:500 topographic maps (DWG/PDF), cross-section drawings and data files, technical design documents, and technical summaries.

records.source_text: 测量员：杨波、周毅、李成杰、巴方人员9人
records.translation: Surveyors: Yang Bo, Zhou Yi, Li Chengjie, and 9 local personnel

records.source_text: ①自带6套华测GPS，主要用途：平面控制网测量，断面测量；
records.translation: ① 6 sets of Huace GPS provided by ourselves; main purpose: horizontal control network survey and cross-section survey;

records.source_text: ②自带1套华测SLAM三维激光扫描仪，主要用途：地形、断面补测；
records.translation: ② 1 set of Huace SLAM 3D laser scanner provided by ourselves; main purpose: supplementary survey of terrain and cross-sections;

records.source_text: ③自带2套天宝电子水准仪，借用项目部水准尺2套，主要用途：高程控制网测量；
records.translation: ③ 2 sets of Trimble electronic levels provided by ourselves, and 2 sets of leveling staffs borrowed from the project department; main purpose: elevation control network survey;

records.source_text: ④借用项目部的无人机1套；
records.translation: ④ 1 set of UAV borrowed from the project department;

records.source_text: ⑤借用项目部的三脚架6个。
records.translation: ⑤ 6 tripods borrowed from the project department.

records.source_text: 计划是10月8号出发并到达项目驻地，项目测量工作具体安排如下表：
records.translation: The plan is to depart on October 8 and arrive at the project camp; the specific arrangement of project survey work is as follows:

records.translation: Purchase tools, materials, and living supplies

records.translation: Set control points (Line C and related branch lines, about 7 km)

records.source_text: 埋设控制点：B线及相关支线,约14km;水准测量：C线及相关支线
records.translation: Set control points: Line B and related branch lines, about 14 km; leveling: Line C and related branch lines
Pile setting and leveling carried out simultaneously

records.source_text: 埋设控制点：A线及相关支线,约16km;水准测量：B线及相关支线
records.translation: Set control points: Line A and related branch lines, about 16 km; leveling: Line B and related branch lines
Pile setting and leveling carried out simultaneously

records.source_text: 水准测量：A线及相关支线
records.translation: Leveling: Line A and related branch lines

records.translation: Data processing and field surveying are carried out simultaneously
